basic_details.job_title: NIT Warangal PostDoc Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

important_dates.list of eligible candidates announcement: To be announced on the institute website and intimated through email or phone
important_dates.interview_date: OFFLINE (To be notified to shortlisted candidates)

age_limit.details: The upper age limit for the PostDoc position is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per the institute rules.

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | postdoc: PhD. degree awarded or Thesis submitted in Computer Science and Engineering and related streams. (Desirable: Applications required to be in the Computer Science and Engineering domain, and can be with allied departments. Candidates should have good programming skills and a basic understanding of Software Engineering, program analysis, and Software Security.)

salary_details.details: HRA and accommodation are provided as per the institute's rules. Other benefits are not applicable.

selection_process: The selection process involves shortlisting based on applications
followed by an offline written test or interview.
Shortlisted candidates will have to attend a written test or interview in offline mode. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
how_to_apply: Download the application proforma attached with the official advertisement from the website nitw.ac.in.
Complete the application form accurately with all required personal and educational details.
Enclose a brief resume, curriculum vitae, or bio-data along with the application form.
Send the soft copy of the completed application and documents via email to [email protected].
Ensure the application reaches the designated email address on or before 11 October 2026 at 5 PM.
important_instructions: The position is purely temporary under the research project. The Committee can keep higher criteria to scrutinise applications based on the number of received applications. The Committee can offer a lower position and emoluments if the minimum experience or criteria are not met. List of eligible candidates will be announced on the institute website and intimated through email or phone. Shortlisted candidates must attend the written test or interview offline at their own expense as no TA/DA is paid. Selected candidates are required to join immediately.

content_sections.heading: NIT Warangal PostDoc Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notification invites application for a PostDoc position under the research project Security Analysis of Software Systems. The exact number of total vacancies is not specified in the notification.

rows.qualification_required: PhD. degree awarded or Thesis submitted in Computer Science and Engineering and related streams. (Desirable: Applications required to be in the Computer Science and Engineering domain, and can be with allied departments. Candidates should have good programming skills and a basic understanding of Software Engineering, program analysis, and Software Security.)

content_sections.heading: NIT Warangal PostDoc Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for the PostDoc position is 35 years . Age relaxation is applicable as per the institute rules.

content_sections.heading: NIT Warangal PostDoc Salary
content_sections.text: HRA and accommodation are provided as per the institute's rules. Other benefits are not applicable.

content_sections.heading: NIT Warangal PostDoc Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process involves shortlisting based on applications, followed by an offline written test or interview. Shortlisted candidates will have to attend a written test or interview in offline mode. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Completed application proforma Brief resume / Curriculum vitae / Bio-data

content_sections.heading: NIT Warangal PostDoc Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The position is purely temporary under the research project. The Committee can keep higher criteria to scrutinise applications based on the number of received applications. The Committee can offer a lower position and emoluments if the minimum experience or criteria are not met. List of eligible candidates will be announced on the institute website and intimated through email or phone. Shortlisted candidates must attend the written test or interview offline at their own expense as no TA/DA is paid. Selected candidates are required to join immediately.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment for at NIT Warangal?
faq.answer: NIT Warangal has invited applications for a temporary PostDoc position under the research project titled Security Analysis of Software Systems in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The exact number of vacancies is not specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application by email is 11 October 2026 at 5 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for NIT Warangal PostDoc?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a PhD degree awarded or thesis submitted in Computer Science and Engineering and related streams, with good programming skills and basic understanding of Software Engineering, program analysis, and Software Security.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years, with age relaxation applicable as per institute rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the PostDoc position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated emolument of Rs. 70,000 per month, along with HRA or accommodation as per institute rules.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Candidates must complete the application proforma, enclose a brief resume or curriculum vitae, and send the soft copy to the email address [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the PostDoc position?
faq.answer: The duration of the PostDoc position is one year.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection mode?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are required to attend an offline written test or interview at NIT Warangal.
